stocks.reason: Q1 FY2027 earnings (reported Sept 23) sent stock down -8.8% to $104.49 on Sept 24 — biggest S&P 500 loser; despite 14% diluted EPS growth, market reacted negatively to slowing growth signals

Shares tumbled -6% as Oracle invoked force majeure on Project Jupiter — Bloom Energy is the fuel-cell power provider for the 2.45GW New Mexico Stargate campus and faces direct revenue risk from project delays
Stock jumped ~7% after demonstrating the industry's first end-to-end real-time quantum error correction decoder running on a standard CPU, tested on 408 logical qubits across 31.5M quantum operations
Biggest S&P 500 winner of the day (+5%); Morgan Stanley raised PT to $254 Overweight and Stephens raised to $280 Overweight, both citing CRWD as a key beneficiary of rising AI-security spend

Shares surged ~18% midday after Sept 23 Financial Analyst Meeting where the data storage company issued optimistic preliminary 2028 guidance and long-term financial framework; Piper Sandler raised PT to $162

Reports of Copilot discounts up to 50% for enterprise customers (30% for 1,000+ seats; 50% for 10,000+ seats) tied to an AI super-app launch in October integrating Copilot, AI coding, and agents into one platform

JPMorgan upgraded to Overweight from Neutral with $125 PT (from $120), citing favorable AI compute pricing backdrop; company pivoting to short-term premium contracts at ~3x long-term rates; stock +1.7% premarket
